question: What will be the highest price EWY trades at on July 23, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Below $168.00": Wins if the official intraday high price of EWY (iShares MSCI South Korea ETF) on July 23, 2026, as reported on NYSE Arca, is strictly below $168.00.
- "$168.00–$169.99": Wins if the official intraday high price of EWY on July 23, 2026 is greater than or equal to $168.00 and strictly below $170.00.
- "$170.00–$171.99": Wins if the official intraday high price of EWY on July 23, 2026 is greater than or equal to $170.00 and strictly below $172.00.
- "$172.00–$173.99": Wins if the official intraday high price of EWY on July 23, 2026 is greater than or equal to $172.00 and strictly below $174.00.
- "$174.00–$175.99": Wins if the official intraday high price of EWY on July 23, 2026 is greater than or equal to $174.00 and strictly below $176.00.
- "$176.00 or above": Wins if the official intraday high price of EWY on July 23, 2026 is greater than or equal to $176.00.

Clarifications:
- "Highest price" refers to the official intraday high for the regular trading session (9:30 AM–4:00 PM ET) on July 23, 2026; pre-market and after-hours prices are excluded.
